contextual_findings.message: The library navigators `page: perps-market-list` and `page: perps-market` wait on `market-list-view` / `perps-market-detail-page` test ids this build does not render, and the perps surface detector labels the market list `unknown` for the same reason. Both fail on main, independent of this PR, so C3 routes by hash and asserts rendered contents directly.

173 resource 404s were logged on the market-list surface (market-row token art). Non-blocking, unrelated to the controller bump, and reported by the runner as `Relation to the task is not determined`.

after.mp4 is no longer referenced by evidence-manifest.json. record-window.sh attaches to the shared screen-capture owner, and the recipe's ac3-clear-capture-orphans node (pkill -9 -f 'capture-helper') terminates that owner mid-run, so the video always finalises ~3s before the run ends and can never pass the after.mp4 -nt summary.json freshness check. The pkill node is load-bearing — it is what keeps ui.screenshot on capture-helper instead of the Page.captureScreenshot fallback — so the video was dropped rather than the node weakened. The PR claims no visual change, so the screenshot alone carries C3.

The two perps-tpsl.spec.ts tests fixed in 20bc12bc01 are Mocha/Selenium e2e and sit outside this recipe's scope — it drives the built extension over CDP and cannot observe e2e mock fixtures. That fix rests on the code-level diagnosis in comments-report.md and is verified by CI, which had not finished at completion time.

suggested_recipe_delta: Once the product adds `market-list-view` and `perps-market-detail-page` test ids, swap the two hash navigations back to `page: perps-market-list` / `page: perps-market` so C3 exercises semantic navigation rather than direct routing.
